_about: Extra items for the Featured grid on / and /links. They are merged with the LEAPPs blog posts by date and the newest four are shown, so an item rotates out as newer posts arrive. Date each item by when it was published (YYYY-MM-DD). Fields: title, date, url (https), excerpt, emoji, kind (a short label such as Video).

items.title: Digital Forensic Analysis of the DeepSeek Application for Android
items.excerpt: A peer-reviewed study in Forensic Sciences (MDPI) by Santos, Frade, Domingues and Negrão. It documents the app's local artefacts and the three DeepSeek modules the authors contributed to ALEAPP.

items.title: La evidencia trae su propia documentación
items.excerpt: My X INFO-CONF 2026 talk at Universidad FASTA, in Spanish: five ways to prove what a field in a mobile artifact means. My part starts at 2:05:40.
